name: menu-to-x
geometry: Hamburger (three bars) → X morph. Top bar rotates +45° toward center, bottom rotates -45° toward center, middle bar fades. Both endpoints (closed/open) exist as static glyphs; the rotation is the choreography.
rationale: The end states are the content (menu = closed, X = open). The rotation between is decoration. Under reduce, the endpoints still exist; the transition is a 120ms opacity crossfade, preserving the affordance without the rotation.
antiPatterns: Crossfade both endpoints simultaneously with no shared frame
Rotation that lags behind a state change for > 80ms
